verses.1: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith.
verses.2: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
verses.3: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
verses.4: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
verses.5: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
verses.6: As they pass through the Valley of Baca,
verses.7: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
verses.8: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
verses.9: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
verses.10: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
verses.11: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
verses.12: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
